findings.title: Scaffold placeholder comment left in the task document
findings.why: The HTML comment is the template text from `wingfoil memory add`, which says to replace it. It was committed as-is, and task-005 has the same comment.

findings.title: Task title and filename name RFC 7386-7396
findings.why: There is no RFC 7396 to 7396 range. The README and code say RFC 7396 obsoletes RFC 7386, so the 7386-7396 naming reads like a range and is inconsistent with them.
